title: Nasdaq Bounces Back After AMD-Meta Deal on AI Chips
title_zh: AMD 与 AI 芯片达成 Meta 交易后纳斯达克指数反弹
summary: Improved consumer-confidence numbers and an announcement by Anthropic about tools that could potentially be used in combination with existing software—rather than as a replacement—also helped bolster market optimism, said  Shannon Saccocia,  chief investment officer of wealth ...
summary_zh: 财富首席投资官香农·萨科西亚 (Shannon Sacccocia) 表示，消费者信心指数的提高以及 Anthropic 宣布可能与现有软件结合使用（而不是作为替代品）的工具也有助于增强市场乐观情绪。

title: Meta strikes massive 6-gigawatt AI chip deal with AMD
title_zh: Meta 与 AMD 达成 6 吉瓦 AI 芯片大规模交易
summary: Meta Platforms (META) landed a multi-year, 6-gigawatt GPU deal with chipmaker Advanced Micro Devices (AMD).
summary_zh: Meta Platforms (META) 与芯片制造商 Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) 达成了一项为期多年的 6 吉瓦 GPU 协议。

title: Anthropic launches new enterprise offerings, raising the heat on software companies
title_zh: Anthropic 推出新的企业产品，引发软件公司的关注
summary: Anthropic is launching a slew of new enterprise capabilities for its AI bot Claude, putting increased pressure on software companies.
summary_zh: Anthropic 正在为其人工智能机器人 Claude 推出一系列新的企业功能，这给软件公司带来了越来越大的压力。

title: Meta and AMD announce 6-gigawatt GPU deal as part of AI build-out, AMD stock jumps
title_zh: Meta 和 AMD 宣布达成 6 吉瓦 GPU 交易，作为人工智能建设的一部分，AMD 股价上涨
summary: Meta and AMD are entering into a multiyear deal as part of the social media giant's massive AI buildout.
summary_zh: Meta 和 AMD 正在达成一项多年期协议，作为这家社交媒体巨头大规模人工智能建设的一部分。
